question: PM Modi to participate in BRICS Summit at Rio de Janeiro in Brazil. How many key priorities have been outlined by Brazil’s BRICS ?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**6**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• PM Modi to participate in BRICS Summit at Rio de Janeiro in Brazil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
PM **Narendra Modi** will attend the **17th BRICS Summit** in **Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.**

 
 
• 
 
He will also make a **bilateral visit to Brasília** — the **first by an Indian PM in nearly 60 years**.

 
 
• 
 
The summit is held at the **Museum of Modern Art (MAM)** in Rio.

 
 
• 
 
**Rio de Janeiro** is known for carnivals, football, mountains, sea, and green vegetation.

 
 
• 
 
**BRICS Members**: Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa + 10 **partner countries.**

 
 
• 
 
**Brazil’s Presidency** has outlined **6 key priorities**:

 
 
• 
 
Global health

 
 
• 
 
Trade, investment & finance

 
 
• 
 
Climate change

 
 
• 
 
AI governance

 
 
• 
 
Peace & security architecture

 
 
• 
 
Institutional development

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**India will host the BRICS Summit in 2026**.
